source: Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 046601 (2026); arXiv:2511.11394v2; official Supplemental Material

acceptance_criteria: Dirichlet energy is nonincreasing, the Chern sector and unit norm are preserved, and supplemental geometry arrays are independently generated.
Exact and small-q flows preserve declared invariants and the finite-mesh Chern transition is refinement stable.
Initial, exact, and small-q trace-deviation fields are generated on one frozen mesh and pass the geometry checks.
Fixed-U and fixed-V sweeps generate energy and Chern observables with the same conventions as the main targets.
